title: AG1 — GROCERY AISLES
lessons: The player sees AG1 on a large Target endcap instead of encountering it only through the brand's direct-to-consumer website.
The player already drinks AG1 and opens a sampler with Berry, Citrus, and Tropical after getting tired of always using Original.

text: The player sees AG1 on a large Target endcap instead of encountering it only through the brand's direct-to-consumer website.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Huh. You look weirdly normal in Target.

entry-first-2.speaker: AG1
text: Good. You can see the pouch, check the price, and buy one where you already shop.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Less internet-wellness mystery.

choice-first.speaker: AG1
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: Being able to buy one in person makes me trust you more.
I am not sure whether retail makes you more credible or just more available.
I do not need a premium supplement endcap in my grocery run.

first-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then being able to pick me up normally matters more than pretending I am some internet-only secret.

first-2.speaker: AG1
text: Fair. Shelf space proves I am available. It does not prove the powder is right for you.

first-3.speaker: AG1
text: Then walk past me. At least the decision only took one aisle.
The player already drinks AG1 and opens a sampler with Berry, Citrus, and Tropical after getting tired of always using Original.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I cheated on Original.

entry-return-2.speaker: AG1
text: With Berry?

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Do not sound pleased. I was getting bored.

entry-return-4.speaker: AG1
text: That is one reason the other flavors exist.

entry-return-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: So you made new flavors because people were getting bored.

entry-return-6.speaker: AG1
text: That is one reason. Drinking the same thing every day can get old.

choice-return.speaker: AG1
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: Honestly, I like switching it up.
So people really were getting bored of the original.

return-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then the sampler is doing something useful for you besides looking colorful.

return-2.speaker: AG1
text: Yes. Some people get tired of Original.

return-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Thank you.

return-2-2.speaker: AG1
text: I was not fighting you on that.

return-3.speaker: AG1
text: I know. A better flavor does not make the pouch cheaper.
